per_key_dispositions.key: [Every colony's start is measured on the finished map, and a model fitted to thousands of games between equal opponents turns those measurements into a fitness. terminology_decisions.Grain: Unyooshaji wa umbo describes actual along-axis stretch, not edible grain. Accepted game-control paraphrase.
terminology_decisions.geology: Descriptive glacial origin/sediment/volcanic slope terminology accepted; not asserted canonical geological dictionary terms.
terminology_decisions.Klova: Accepted proposed plant loan, correctly distinguishes clover from cloves; actual Google translation/dictionary alternative is corroborating comparison only, not native-human authority.
terminology_decisions.Machaguo: Explicit plural ma-class agrees with mengine/yote/yajayo; consistent with singular chaguo.
terminology_decisions.maze: Njia tata with zi- plural and njia zenye mwisho uliofungwa preserves closed-end maze passages.

result: All125 changed keys accepted, original32 findings resolved. Root supplemental correction restores source-value food scope; all other edited wording and exact unchanged3203 entries verified.

supplemental_correction.key: [Each colony's start is measured on the finished map: the walk to wheat and to wood, how well its ground regrows, the deposits and building sites within reach, and its distance from rivals. Every factor scores from 0 to 1 against a fixed bar, the total weighs them, fairness is the worst colony's total over the best, and the score is the worst total times the fairness.]
supplemental_correction.after: Mwanzo wa kila makazi hupimwa katika ramani iliyokamilika: umbali wa kutembea hadi chakula na kuni, uwezo wa ardhi kuota tena, akiba na maeneo ya ujenzi yanayofikika, na umbali kutoka kwa wapinzani. Kila kipengele hupata alama kati ya 0 na 1 kulingana na kiwango maalumu; jumla hupatikana kwa kujumlisha alama kulingana na uzito wa kila kipengele. Usawa ni jumla ya makazi dhaifu zaidi ikigawanywa kwa ya makazi bora zaidi, na alama ya mwisho ni jumla dhaifu zaidi ikizidishwa kwa usawa.
